payload.subject: Decouple synth.js: lazy-load command groups and thin CLI entrypoint
payload.name: Decouple synth.js: lazy-load command groups and thin CLI entrypoint
payload.goal: Refactor src/cli/synth.ts so the top-level entrypoint performs only argument parsing + dispatch. Each command group (expedition, mission, program, explain, verify, docs, etc.) is loaded lazily on first invocation; the 13-step bootstrap, all adapters, Mission Studio, and Planning Cognition are imported only by commands that need them. Measurable target: cold-start of 'synth version' / 'synth status' must not load adapters or Mission Studio. Deliverable: lazy loader + per-group entrypoints + a cold-start benchmark.
